Hey there @klaasnicolaas, @frenck, mind taking a look at this pull request as it has been labeled with an integration (`forecast_solar`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L170) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
Could you reference the upstream change ?

@balloob Could you indicate whether this was a mistake or whether the power values were deliberately converted to kiloWatts (only wrong unit of measurement) 😄 Let's wait with the merge

Referentie change: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/edf42bab25ae2e3681f3d0e774b7eebdaaa87ce3#diff-487db8875e6e9587ed45d35f8099c58a3ccbeaf096b963dd3c763753e6e8934a

https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/forecast_solar/releases/tag/2.0.0

Breaking changes
#12 #13 This library now represents all data as-is from the API. It will no longer change timezones to UTC and it will no longer change all values from W to kW.
See the Estimate class for the latest properties and methods.

The way I read it, I've removed /1000 from the only remaining one that has a unit of measurement of Watts.
The remaining /1000 that are in the code have a measurement of kWh, so I think this is correct.
The API indeed shows data as-is. The choice for it to be kW should be in HA instead to remain the same as before. So let's change the unit so it's like the last release.
I'm happy to go with the consensus. Other sensors in the integration seem to use watts. ?
Considering `Watts` are most commonly used, I think we should stick to this unit indeed. In that case, adjust the other power_production entities.
I've updated the other power entities to correctly shows Watts and updated the tests.
Let me know if you want me to go the other way and make them all kW and change the units to KILO_WATTS ?

> The API indeed shows data as-is. The choice for it to be kW should be in HA instead to remain the same as before. So let's change the unit so it's like the last release.

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/forecast_solar/
Says that they are all in watts ?
